notes.title: Road to Release and Beyond
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today I wish to talk about upcoming releases and plans for beyond. After four and half years of Hollow Mine's solo development, it's time to head for 1.0 release! Thank you all for following development process, play testing the game and contributions. You are amazing!

Once the Hollow Mine is released you can expect series of patches including content extensions in following months. This approach will ensure a cyclic refreshment post 1.0 release and make the game more interesting.

During the post release period your feedback will be crucial, next updates will include changes in response to your ideas and reported bugs. Nothing changes, you can expect further game development together with the community.

notes.title: What's coming? Exciting Changes in v.0.8 - Devlog
notes.notes:
Hello! It's time to share what I was working on since the Steam Next Fest ended. Most of the changes are influenced by feedback i got from this event. I hope you are going to like it.

[h2]Upcoming Features and Changes:[/h2]

[b]NEW Main Menu Illustration[/b]
The Artist Jakub Tito Kašiar made new main menu illustration for Hollow Mine. No more boring menu! Thanks to new illustration, game feels much more atmospheric and climatic. It should bring more positive feelings for the players and send a message that Hollow Mine is a real deal. I hope you like it, let me know in the comments what you think about the new main menu illustration.

You can find Jakub Tito Kašiar here: [url=https://www.instagram.com/kasiarjakub/]https://www.instagram.com/kasiarjakub/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/5a1f58acf5a661f177786ecf9969b8b21541661b.png[/img]

[b]Improved Lighting[/b]
Since the beginning of times I heard feedback saying that "Why I am blocked to dig" and during intense action combat players would say "I don't see what is going on". I definitely agree with this comments. I decided to try to fix it by introducing new room lighting. 

After couple trials and errors I finally figured how to apply lighting to the rooms in the way that fits the game and it's not buggy. I managed to accomplish it! Now active area of the room is much brighter, beyond the room border - background is darker. It wasn't that hard as I thought it would be. 

With new lighting players will be able to see the walkable and destroyable area more easily. It should also help with intense combat action moments to focus the eyes on the area that is actually relevant the most. 

In forest biome the lighting gradient is less affecting the background, because it's outside area. Internal closed biomes, like mine biome, will have background blacked out. 

I hope you will like the new lighting for rooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/9edf94fe5576d480ca6517b92301a2fcf80ea38d.png[/img]

[b]Bouncy Projectiles Ability[/b]
Do you experience issues with aiming straight on the enemies? Say nothing! Just try bouncy projectiles to increase your chance to hit anything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/a5d7ee4c02cf3c0a1ce43f645499f714612bba0b.gif[/img]

[b]Greater Fireball Magic Spell[/b]
Do walls stand in your way to get to evil creatures? No longer! Use Greater Fireball spell with ability to break walls on impact. The projectiles are, so big they can also damage surrounding enemies in small range.

* - And yes it's possible to break ore veins with this spell ;-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/0c58fff7ffc857a7fc142af3fab1d1904b95e5c7.gif[/img]

[b]Making Game More Challenging[/b]
Hollow Mine is suppose to be a bullet hell game, unfortunately it's still not there yet. Enemies in the game needs a lot of adjustments. I introduced a set of changes and improvements to make it possible, see below:

[list]
[*] Enemy attack patterns will be more various now, leaving less reaction time and making them more challenging.
[*] Dash will make player evade enemy projectiles and enemy attacks now.
[*] Enemies will be lighter to push back when player is body blocked.
[*] Enemy animations will be adjusted to improve signaling attacks to the player more
[*] After receiving the hit, player short invincibility ghost will last less time now (1s -> 0.35s, 2s -> 0.7s - with Double Ghost Ability)
[/list]  
These changes are aimed to make the combat more challenging and dynamic. Player gained the possibility to dash through the bullets unharmed, in exchange for introducing more complex bullet patterns - similar to Enter the Gungeon game.

[b][i]If you are experienced bullet hell player with a lot of hours into games similar to Hollow Mine, please contact me on discord. I would love to chat and hear the feedback ;-)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/bc360f4a2a48d2e7eb8c2d21ca723df21048b58a.gif[/img]

[b]Forest Biome New Floor Tiles Colors[/b]
It was always a case where I couldn't figured out the proper colors for Hollow Mine. I am programmer first and art comes second. I'm actually learning pixel art while developing Hollow Mine. Throughout the years I improved in pixel art style. I recommend to watch the old devlogs or articles about the game to see the difference. I hope I improved at least - let me know in comments :-P

As I get more knowledge about pixel art and colors, I use it to improve the game. These new floor tiles colors should be much more pleasing to see, especially during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/b2876661db817367e3f948cfa3f2fa4373a64110.png[/img]

[b]Picking Abilities NEW UI Effect[/b]
Level up and moment of picking new ability is significant. I decided to improve this moment with a small highlight animation for each of the ability card. I hope you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/a798b97bb13100fd7d79b1a37d108cb7a3bc480e.gif[/img]

[b]Improved Screen Shake[/b]
Screen shake is controversial topic - most people don't like it and feel dizzy from watching it (no worries there is option in the settings to turn it off). Still I wanted to make it properly this time, it's no longer animated, and the shake direction follows the crosshair now. This change should make the hits more impactful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/1250c564dd6a8b780dec133b3ec6a33863dc2aeb.gif[/img]

[b]Red Border Effect Indicating Player Receiving Hit[/b]
Short ghost character animation, SFX sound and hearts animation triggering on player receiving hit might not be enough to signalize this event. Now short red screen border animation will help to make that event more noticeable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/916cb6f74ceaf25596057b01b248da520af6e4eb.gif[/img]

[b]Under Player Stamina Bar Indicator[/b]
Stamina is one of things that players need to monitor at all times during combat, to strategies and plan next moves according to it's current status. Now it should be more convenient to see the current stamina status under the character feet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/fadca1198c3c73a7da92c1af292722a99f4a76dc.gif[/img]

[b]Blood Axe Weapon[/b]
New unique axe weapon is coming to Hollow Mine, with ability to leech life on enemy death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/9e16aa6c6f2127bce9fb93b2f264bfbeb94c0f81.png[/img]

Whole axe weapon set:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/7a4c0b6fa87ce823cd8a11d3cff5f5c9a229df46.png[/img]

[b]Dash Icon[/b]
It wasn't always clear when the dash is available - there's small cooldown delay to use it. Now with a special dash icon on the player panel UI it should be much more visible. 

Someday we will figure out how to put it on character as well ;-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/2714e1fd96ea1488c9514b70997bd457a51d0601.gif[/img]

[b]Forbidden Cheese Item[/b]
Bomb-like item that instead of exploding can poison the enemies and slow them down. It can be used to get a great synergy with demobilize enemy ability that causes foes to receive 200% while in poison state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/757d99e0a6a5b467a5a31ae972ac581469ce44ad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/5b9af0ef0bb7bb7119d4f1ae20aa85c832557515.gif[/img]

[b]There are other features and fixes incoming like:[/b]

[list]
[*] UI base resolution from 320x180 to 400x225 
[*] Fixing spear weapon range
[*] Improving rolling Item box behavior to be more intuitive
[*] Increasing experience requirements to level up
[*] Making level up pick ability UI appear instantly
[*] New room type with enemy second spawn event
[*] Further balancing for abilities, item drops, resources.
[*] Fixing double chest with spawn for unlocking room
[*] etc.
[/list]

These changes were also partially influenced by Mr. Delightful huge feedback left on Hollow Mine Demo Page inside a review posted on 4th of March 2025. [b]Having a review on demo page is really helpful - please do it :-)[/b]

You can find Mr. Delightful playing Hollow Mine on his YouTube channel here:
https://youtu.be/OLyxesLxUvE?si=8AkD4MXLO8LySMs8

[i]Disclaimer: Please note that all features and adjustments mentioned here might be still subject to change.[/i]

[b]When the v.0.8 update will be released?[/b]
You can expect to see it around 13 of April 2025

Thank you everyone for participation in testing the demo and giving feedback. The game is growing in direction to make it even more polished, engaging and fun.

Stay tuned! Cheers!

Michal Parysz

notes.title: 0.7.1.17 - 0.7.1.19 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello! Today I have another small set of fixes and adjustments. Thanks for reporting bugs and giving feedback. These changes are aimed to make mine biome more challenging and to make player leverage digging resources and crafting tables more.

[list]
[*] Reduced weapons durability (Swords/Spears/Axes/Daggers - Copper/Iron/Diamond - by 25 hits).
[*] Decreased rare ore spawns in the Mine biome.
[*] Removed golden chest rewards from Mine biome rooms.
[*] Fixed death effect wave of bullets not triggering in Swarm and Survival rooms.
[*] Fixed an issue where picked-up items were not treated as new items, besides previously dropped ones.
[*] Fixed control scheme not being properly set after teleporting action - it was preventing player to move after teleporting back from mine camp.
[/list]

I hope you like the adjustment's. Cheers! :-)

Michal Parysz

notes.title: 0.7.1.14 - 0.7.1.16 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello! Thanks for testing demo and sending feedback. Here is a list with recent changes. These new changes are aimed to improve overall quality of gameplay and especially loot system to make crafting and mining more important. There are also more rooms with loot penalties for avoiding manual mining.

[list]
[*] Change chest drops to reduce the number of weapons.
[*] Increase chance of ores and blueprint drops from chests.
[*] Simplify the forest biome swarm room by reducing it to 2 waves and making spawn delay longer.
[*] Fix on-death effect projectiles not disappearing after a wave.
[*] Enable auto-loot penalty in survival and swarm rooms.
[*] Adjust ore drop chances by increasing iron and sulfur in the mine biome and reducing them in the forest biome.
[*] Adjust ore drop chances by increasing diamond and quartz in mine biomes while reducing them in the forest biome.
[*] Increase pickaxe attack speed and lower stamina cost.
[*] Increase loot penalty.
[*] Modify the size of critical messages.
[*] Increase animation time for digging and attacking using empty hands.
[*] Reduce explosive goblin speed and health.
[*] Reducing critical text size back to normal
[/list]

I hope you like the adjustment's. Cheers! :-)

Michal Parysz

notes.title: 0.7.1.1 - 0.7.1.13 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello! I hope you are well, thank you all for playing demo and reporting bugs. There was 13 releases with small fixes since 0.7 release. Almost everything was done during steam next fest event, so it was a heat time. Gladly Hollow Mine seems more stable and responsive with more proper difficulty.


[list]
[*] Wizard and Rogue are unlocked now for everyone to try in demo - enjoy ;-)
[*] Changed diamond and quartz sell price to 10
[*] unified critical hit text size/color; increased projectile pool size
[*] slightly enlarged fire ground sprites - to make them noticeable more
[*] added +10% movement speed initially - to make the characters more responsive
[*] reduced light boots movement bonus by 10%.
[*] Swarm room automatically starts the first wave - to make the players defeat the easiest wave at least instead of consistency skipping it using red button, or by mistake learning the game
[*] Disabled fading music when settings change; removed “save zone” label on tutorial descends.
[*] Corrected mining translation and dashing text.
[*] Set certain too long SFX as music - once music is muted it won't play these effects like level up or boss presentation tracks.
[*] Turned off tutorial camp music when entering forest camp.
[*] Increased enemie's, health, movement speed, and decreased attack cooldowns
[*] Added translations for various languages (excluding Japanese and Chinese for now).
[*] Fixed missing letter “T” in Polish translation.
[*] Reduced screen shake
[*] Improved enemy attack animations and health 
[*] Reduced freeze time; enhanced visibility of mining indicator
[*] Increased dagger durability.
[*] Corrected wood axe blueprint outcome to wood axe instead of wood sword
[*] Blocked swapping an item into the same slot
[*] Reset damage parameter to character’s core damage when updating gear - it was messing calculations for total damage
[*] When crafting outcome items should have full durability; 
[*] Stackable items now drop with their stack intact.
[*] Block Waypoint teleport when interacting with other entities in Before the Boss Room
[*] And lot of other small fixes and adjustment's
[/list]

I hope you like the progress. Game keeps growing and I'm glad there is more and more of you. More people that are willing to contribute and be part of this growing HM community! :-) Thank you!

Michal Parysz

notes.title: What's coming? Major Changes in v.0.7 Steam Next Fest Demo Edition
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today, I’m excited to share what’s coming in the [b]Hollow Mine v0.7 Steam Next Fest Demo Edition[/b]. 

Before we start I would like to say to everyone thank you - having a game on [b]Steam Next Fest [/b]and preparing it to release was always my dream. It wouldn't be possible without your support people! Thank you all for help by playing, reporting bugs, giving feedback and ideas! Also game evolved like that, because of all this contributions from you. Let's keep it like that! 

Join Discord or Steam Community to share your experiences with others about Hollow Mine. You are all welcome to join :-)

[h2]Upcoming Features and Changes:[/h2]

[b]Fire Mage Character[/b]
Master of the blazing arts, channeling mystical flames to incinerate foes with relentless fire and fury. Character will have increased ability to ignite enemies and damage from burning effect. Also the new Spell Rain of Fire with dealing AOE damage and instantly igniting surrounding enemies will be inside the starting equipment.

To unlock the Fire Mage, blow up 50x enemies using bomb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/dbd45ddca4bb3296ef71a9891bb6adde7e23247e.gif[/img]

[b]Spell Rain of Fire[/b]
It's another spell with AOE effect next to Ice Nova Spell. Get close to enemies cast a spell and watch how they receive damage and ignite instantly. Having increase burning damage should work well in combination with this spell. The spell will be available in initial Fire Mage equipment and in Sage's shop, you can find this NPC in mine encampment room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/572a71411853b20ecbbc834b0635d297c397efb6.gif[/img]

[b]Knight Character[/b]
A heavily armored warrior, expert in close combat, brawling, and deflecting hits. His resilience and mastery of defense make him an unstoppable force on the battlefield.

To unlock the Knight defeat mine biome boss once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/a254377795eaa3fa75e4519592f76fc515eadc84.gif[/img]

[b]Menu Music Loop[/b]
New Menu music loop won't stop, there is a new ambient sound that will play after every main menu theme loop. It should make atmosphere a little bit more enjoyable while waiting to play the game in main menu.

[b]Activate Altar Room Music[/b]
While being in the room new music will play increasing the seriousness of the place and significance of the decision player is going to make to activate the artifact - Weles Burden Ring, or not.

[b]SFX Sounds[/b]
There will be more variety of SFX sounds available for players to hear during gameplay. Sounds for critical damage, almost breaking weapon or rolling items from the box and more.

[b]Angry Bee Enemy[/b]
This enemy will have a way easier style of attack - it fires 4 red bullets instantly in one direction each. It's much more easier enemy, all to make it more fair at the beginning of the game. This enemy can be found in Forest Biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/c69d8f2bc43f6b2892246d9ea1646ecf52b00808.gif[/img]

[b]Forest Camp Starting Area[/b]
Starting area with waypoint, merchant NPC and Kettle Crafting Table for potions was added. It will serve as a initial point to inform a player a bit about the lore and also it will allow new players to onboard into the game more easily. 

* - Using waypoint player can teleport back to this area. Another waypoint is inside mine encampment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/3f619af212c6ff4fd40566d8c87c9e19547d6318.png[/img]

[b]Merchant NPC[/b]
In order to help with onboarding new Merchant NPC was added to new starting Forest Camp - with items like (cheaper) health potion, bombs, basic blueprints. healthy herb and teleport scroll . Players will be able to use starting coins to buy & decide what suits them the best. 

* - Teleport scroll allows to create a portal and come back to waypoint and back to the room once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/0ec1d6fb7c86c96e14b4935432372b6b4c134229.gif[/img]

That’s it! You can also expect a bunch of other cool improvements and fixes. The complete changelog will be also available soon. See you on the release at 24th of February - the beginning of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] I hope you are excited!!

Cheers!

notes.title: What's coming? Major Changes in v.0.6 Demo
notes.notes:
Hello!
Today, I’m excited to share what’s coming in the Hollow Mine v0.6 demo. Game is reshaping constantly and I am just surprised that recent features changed the game so much. I hope you will also enjoy it.

[h2]Upcoming Features and Changes:[/h2]

[b]New Character: Ice Mage[/b]
The Ice Mage is master of the frozen arts, wielding mystical powers to unleash devastating icy forces upon foes. Ice Mage will be able to deal more damage to foes being in frozen or even poisoned state - thanks to new abilities introduced in the game (more below). Character will be a powerful alternative to Mage with Ice Ball Scroll and Ice Nova Spell in initial equipment. Guaranteed abilities that aligns with character also enhances AOE capabilities.

To unlock the Ice Mage, defeat mine biome boss 3x with Mage hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/050b4481095404279045257760baff0e451682de.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/639d2c0ae996d66bde9d01214516cfb9e8373c52.gif[/img]

[b]Forest and Mine Biome New Decorations[/b]
Stones in forest biome and bones in mine biome were added around the room's unreachable area. Improving the visuals is a major factor and still is very important at this stage of development and it will be continued when ever there will be opportunity to do so. I hope you will like this new looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/2c5061a02b39466b07418802dd420befb95d3cda.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/6836ee66fec64c5c0b8dbe964ef926cecbddb0b6.png[/img]

[b]New Unique Abilities[/b]
[list]
[*] Ice Arrows - Bow fires arrow projectiles with +20% increased chance to cause freeze effect
[*] Reapers Ricochete - When an enemy dies, nearby foes receive damage
[*] Deaths Echo - When an enemy dies, your next hit deals double damage
[*] Demobilize Enemy - Poisoned or frozen enemies receive +200% increased damage
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/0bf4ec4045d09e4515b3b3e0f1b9c7453cc6ce22.gif[/img]

[b]New Dracula Boss[/b]
Boss was included in Mine Biome Bosses pool. It makes it as another demo end boss next to Boruta Royal Devil. Different play style - mostly range and casting spells attacks should bring more variety and give new challenge for a players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/e69ff74045c30817a6e25f0ace7679330527e336.gif[/img]

[b]Common Unique Abilities[/b]
There are more and more abilities in the game - 30 unique abilities in total! Finding a special combo that aligns with character style is very rare. To prevent that, characters will have higher chance to get abilities that suits them.

[b]New standard Abilities[/b]
[list]
[*] Infernal surge - Increases burning damage (25%/50%/100%) 
[*] Venom taste - Increases chance (10%/20%/30%) to poison the enemy on hit
[/list]

[b]Major rebalancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Every weapon damage was adjusted to new average
[*] Standard abilities values were increased
[*] Overpowered abilities like triple shot, double cast will get reduced damage
[*] Mine Biome Bosses health was increased
[*] Enemy alert range was increased in combat and survival rooms
[*] Bosses and enemy attacks are faster with more transparent animations
[*] Some enemies can poison or freeze hero now
[/list]

[b]Burning, poison and freeze unit state effects[/b]
Now enemies and hero once affected by fire, poison or freezing effects will glow in matching color. This should better visualize the current state of the units and bring more cool visuals into the game. (Look above in casting ice nova spell gif how enemies glow light blue)

[b]Enemy short attack red glow[/b]
Enemies will have a short red glow during attacks. Thanks to that it will be more transparent when and how damage was received and help to avoid it more easily especially with melee enemies.

[b]New and improved inventory stacking features[/b]
Dragging stackable items on top of each other now adds up the stack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/567ba8982f57c7c43487b91ad67a660b2ff4ae5c.gif[/img]

[b]Game over / Victory Screen UI Improvements[/b]
Ability to see all the details on ending screen will summarize your runs in more detail. Now you will be able to even share screen shots to other people in our discord community special channel "#score-share" just use in game button to get there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/a12d2f22b18824b13aeea376a98194921e5417ff.png[/img]

[b]Extended Player Statistics UIs[/b]
Now it will be possible to see all the abilities picked in Player Statistics Panel, it will be really helpful during picking abilities to have a glance on what we already have to make better decisions in creating builds for our heros.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/44ccf1a36dfb8f6c38d09b3f99599a82c118d2df.png[/img]

That’s it! You can also expect a bunch of smaller improvements and fixes. The complete changelog will be also available soon.

Cheers!

notes.title: What's coming? Major Changes in v.0.5 Demo
notes.notes:
Hello!
Today, I’m excited to share what’s coming in the Hollow Mine v0.5 demo. I’m thrilled that our small community is growing thank you for being here and helping to test the early demos of Hollow Mine. I’m committed to continuing to bring you updates, and in this version, I’m introducing the NEW Rogue character alongside various small fixes and improvements. ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Upcoming Features and Changes:[/h2]

[b]New Character: Rogue[/b]
The Rogue is a master of stealth and precision. Armed with a dagger, they excel at striking from the shadows, using agility and wit to outmaneuver enemies. The Rogue will be able to evade any hit while dashing (after first level up). With fast movement to get in and out of combat, combined with a rapid attack rate, this character offers an exciting and dynamic play style.

To unlock the Rogue, you’ll need to discover the secret room in the mine biome twice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/288a5b755fd1b8ac21f655fd80f1677f04668b6d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/109012d87310e4bced78a98361f90350beb5a24e.gif[/img]

[b]NEW: Dagger Weapon Set[/b]
Daggers are lightweight weapons with quick strikes and short range. They serve as the primary weapon for the Rogue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/2e8472f56ed3d5b1ae297a1dea3b2ddfda570cf4.png[/img]

[b]Preferred Abilities[/b]
Each character now has a preferred ability that is guaranteed to appear upon their first level up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/7a35f58eb33753a3540d3cc3fbb4fdc55b645f7c.png[/img]

[b]Player Panel UI Improvements[/b]
Based on feedback, the current Panel UI—especially the hearts, stamina, and experience bars has been difficult to see. In the next update, you can expect improvements: hearts will be larger and feature an additional outline, making it easier to determine your current health status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/7a9f3f7c210dc135f5baca7ef467c58001f319a7.png[/img]

[b]Enemy Spawning Animation[/b]
Enemies will now spawn after a short animation, giving players a brief moment to prepare before engaging in standard room battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/41a465a0bde918ffd8dc1d3358975a26ef1c9b25.gif[/img]

That’s it for now! You can also expect a bunch of smaller improvements and fixes. The complete changelog will be available on the release day, which is just a few days away.

Cheers!

notes.title: What's coming? Major Changes in v.0.4 Demo
notes.notes:
Hello! Today I wish to share with you what is coming in Hollow Mine v0.4 demo. In last weeks I received tremendous amount of feedback and it was very helpful. Next set of changes will bring [b]NEW character Dwarf[/b] and also it will include a lot of UX/UI improvements in order to make the game even more easy to navigate and play. And not only that! There's more! look at list below. ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Upcoming Features and changes:[/h2]

[b]Character Dwarf[/b]
Master of construction and axe user. He specialises in smashing the enemies with an axe and creating towers. You can expect to push enemies around with huge knock back effect and manage towers that fire projectiles and help your hero in the fight

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/6f363df3f9492657dbe7acd0ed8b5054d7f577ca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/8c27a708b301e45aa2afd4bb61af1bd4ab6190b2.gif[/img]

[b]Room modifiers and detailed info panel[/b]
Modifiers is a clever extension I am excited about, that will make rooms even more diverse and challenging. During a game it will be possible to access a room dashboard with all the information at once:

[list]
[*] Short room objective description
[*] Additional explanation on how to complete a room
[*] Room modifiers with enemy health, walk speed, alert radius and experience parameters
[*] Bigger size mini map
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/6baf375ee73b64d1ff882e2d1d23c6716e9db2c0.png[/img]

[b]Picking Item for crafting UI window[/b]
From feedback and several gameplays it was obvious that equipping items to start crafting was pretty challenging experience. From now on it won't be necessary to do that, instead once at crafting table there will be new window asking to select item for crafting. This approach should be more player friendly and less annoying to navigate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/cfcdb77d849cbba845ad5857584618987eac6024.png[/img]

[b]Crafting UI window improvements[/b]
New UI Window for crafting will be much bigger it will make it more visible and pleasant for an eye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/12182011fbdede2a4e888480000495156f5be3ee.png[/img]

And it's still not all. You can expect to have a new room type and bunch of smaller improvements that will make the game even more approachable. Stay tuned!

notes.title: What's coming? Major Changes in v.0.3 Demo
notes.notes:
Hello! I hope you’re excited because the upcoming Hollow Mine v0.3 demo is packed with new features. I’ve carefully reviewed feedback from players and YouTubers, and I’m working on a range of exciting changes to enhance your experience!

My main goal is to make the gameplay more intuitive and help players better understand how to navigate Hollow Mine. I’m also enhancing progression with new abilities and an improved crafting system. You’ll feel your character growing stronger, with more opportunities to upgrade weapons through crafting. Additionally, I’m addressing the issue of weapon durability—there will always be new weapons available when you’re close to running out.

[h2]Upcoming Features and changes:[/h2]

[b]Character Amazon[/b]
Master of agility and polearm user. She specialises at keeping the enemies at bay while fighting with spear

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/fb9abd8a3111e4127a9e77c012b4fe778e3f1053.gif[/img]

[b]Extended Settings[/b]
With new options to enable/disable vsync, screen shake and camera effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/4f8e311711f0e6f7d3665b71d86546536d452571.png[/img]

[b]Tutorial section about collecting experience and leveling up[/b]
Game didn't informed enough that collecting balls left by enemies makes your character to level up. Now there will be a dedicated section about it in tutorial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/e7c112bd88dd03f738bf6dc613e8f0ee085ecf5f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/57567c9cad71a21116e445ac9ca3187b070f6c19.gif[/img]

[b]Tutorial section about destroying walls, mining and collecting ores[/b]
Similar case, game didn't teach enough about mining. Digging manually rewards player more, than waiting until the end of room. [b]Once room is finished mining veins blow up and give less ores. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/596b3a43e04fecc13ecd8dc1366ab26d72c7daa5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/dd481c634a1bb278c335cb317b4786e0ccee5d78.gif[/img]

[b]Upgraded Character Picker[/b]
New and reorganized character picker window with dedicated section for statistics and initial inventory of individual heros.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/9f86eeb94a939e6021cd9aa83dd4ba710489a10c.gif[/img]

There are a lot of lesser changes that improves feel of the game, improves UI and resolves annoying bugs.
